skills.description: Run exactly three rounds of bounded code review on the current branch. After round three, output a per-round findings-and-fixes summary, answer the three convergence meta-questions, and give a CONVERGED / NOT CONVERGED verdict plus a list of unresolved items. Use when feature development is done and ready to merge, or when the user asks for a three-round / bounded / convergence code review (also in Chinese: "跑三轮 CR", "有界审查", "收敛性审查").
